messages:
jordan: FYI opened 3 cross-repo PRs that need ordering/approvals. SDK change depends on API header rename. Console needs helm chart bump that includes SDK client v2. Runtime needs a compatibility shim. Links: http://git/internal/api-pr http://git/internal/sdk-pr http://git/internal/console-pr

maria: pinged API reviewers @ben and @sasha. can we sequence merges to avoid break? :thinking:

ben: I'll pick up API review today. change looks small but we need a short migration guide. do we have any backward-compat tests?

sasha: runtime side: we can accept the old header for ~2wks behind a feature flag. will add a shim. please add an env var in helm values, e.g. ALLOW_OLD_X.

jordan: added an env var to console helm values and SDK client default. sample snippet:
```
values.yaml
featureFlags:
  allowOldX: true
```

maria: cool. Ben, if you merge API first, SDK can bump and console helm after. any objections?

ben: ok, will do final pass then merge API. will add compat note to PR description. ETA EOD PST.

eli: devops-bot: CI for SDK PR failed on lint (import order). @maria can you take a quick fix?

maria: on it, fixing lint now.

devops-bot: CI status: api-pr ✅, sdk-pr ❌ (lint), console-pr ✅. full logs: http://ci/internal/4319

sasha: runtime will cut a canary once console helm is bumped. ping me when console image tag is ready.

jordan: plan: (1) ben merges API (2) maria fixes SDK lint & we merge SDK (3) console helm bump + chart release (4) runtime canary. label PRs with crossrepo/blocking.

eli: added label crossrepo/blocking to all 3 PRs.

maria: SDK lint fixed, tests passing. re-requesting review @ben.

ben: review done, looks good. merging after CI completes.

devops-bot: SDK PR CI ✅. merged by ben at 4319876572.

jordan: thanks team :tada: I'll write a short postmortem note in #eng-platform summarizing the sequence and gotchas.

sasha: received console tag, starting canary now.

eli: runtime canary healthy after ~10m. no errors in traces.

maria: closing thread, thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
